declared_mix.counterfactual_shape: per family x lang cell: K=2 -> 4 triples + 2 pairs; K=3 -> 4 triples; K=8 -> 4 triples. Triple = original + decisive variant (gold moves) + control paraphrase (gold stays). Pair = original + decisive variant (K=8 load excepted: pairs are K=2 only).

eval_format_protocol: Every compared model receives exactly ONE input format, fixed here before any measurement on this cut. The format is derived from the episode-v1 comparative contract (data/episode_contract.py, COMPARATIVE_CONTEXT, predates this battery): families with wants_context True (attribute_comparison, priority_decision) are scored with the full candidate block in the premise; the rest (extraction_paraphrase, description_classification, textual_inference_negation) are scored one candidate at a time against an identical candidate context. If a model needs explicit hypotheses and another does not, the difference is documented and justified in the eval card -- the format that favours one of them is never chosen after looking at results.

gold_rule.decisive: gold(decisive) = (gold(original) + step) mod K, step = 1 + (H(group, flip) mod (K-1)), so gold always moves
gold_rule.note: The rule fixes the SLOT before any prose exists; the author then writes facts that make that slot correct. Gold is never the author's judgement of finished text, and never rebalanced after a measurement.
gold_rule.original: gold(original) = H(group, orig) mod K, H = int(sha256('battery-dev-gold-v1' + group + role))

namespace_rule: Development variant_group values MUST match ^dev- and MUST NOT start with sealed-. The sealed battery (#T-battery-sealed) MUST use the sealed- prefix. Prefix discipline is enforced by test now; group-intersection with the sealed cut is enforced by test as soon as the sealed file lands. Rationale: disjointness by construction, checkable with grep, no shared registry needed.
note: Declared BEFORE generating a single case (task: mix written and dated first). Any cut whose composition is adjusted after seeing a result no longer measures anything. Real distribution is checked against this file with the tolerance below.

scoring_weights.headline: macro over families (each family 1/5); chance baseline per K written next to every figure

tolerance.cell_family_lang_k: exact match required (|delta| <= 0 read as pass; alarm threshold |delta| > 2)
